assumptions: Counted shipments with status = 'delivered' and delivered_date in May 2026 (>= '2026-05-01' and < '2026-06-01').
delivered_date is stored as ISO date text (YYYY-MM-DD) so string comparison by date boundaries is appropriate.
Excluded shipments with NULL delivered_date or statuses other than 'delivered'.
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments WHERE status = 'delivered' AND delivered_date >= '2026-05-01' AND delivered_date < '2026-06-01';
